timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: That feedback was difficult to hear.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep replaying the words in my mind.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me feels defensive right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I am worried that I am not good enough.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: I can feel the tension in my body.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I wish the conversation had gone differently.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am turning one opinion into a verdict.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this feedback hurt.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This moment is taking up a lot of space.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can pause before deciding what this means.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Feedback is information, not my identity.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can separate the useful part from the delivery.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I do not have to agree with every word.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is allowed to come out of defense.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can be learning and still be capable.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can ask for clarity instead of assuming the worst.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can treat myself with respect while I reflect.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let this moment become more manageable.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the discomfort to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you respond.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can choose what is useful and release the rest.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust myself to learn without shrinking.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can turn clear feedback into one next step.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: My strengths still exist alongside areas to grow.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel steady and open.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am capable of having a thoughtful follow-up.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can improve without attacking who I am.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I decide how I carry this forward.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to take the next useful step.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. You can return to the feedback when you are ready, with more steadiness and more choice. Thank you for taking this time for yourself.
